shared_elements: standing human figures in strict profile
processional row of figures facing the same direction
long fringed/patterned robes with rendered pleats or hem borders
figures carrying small held objects in the hand
hands raised or extended toward the figure ahead
horizontal register band with a ground line
justification: Both depict rows of bearded male figures in strict profile, wearing long fringed robes with carefully patterned hems and hair, walking or standing in a directional procession along a register line and carrying or extending objects with the hands, a fairly specific processional/tribute scheme rather than a generic figural scene. The main differences in content are scale and complement: A shows only a few monumental figures in a single band, while B stacks several registers and adds chariots, horses and led animals absent from A.
